secretLoveNote:
Amar priyo Sathi,

Ei chhoto boita banalam shudhu amader prottekta muhurto ke jotno kore rakhbo bole. Jibone onek kichhu bodle jabe, somoy chole jabe, kintu ei patagulote amader hashi, golpo, ar ekshathe thakar onubhutigulo chirodin thakbe.

Tumi amar shobcheye sundor ovvesh, amar shanti, ar amar prottekta diner shobcheye bhalo onsho. Tumi pashe thakle shadharon din-o oshadharon hoye jay. Prottekta monthsary, prottekta bochor amra evabei ekshathe notun notun smriti ei boitar patay joma korbo.

Ami tomake khub bhalobashi, ajke, kal, ar chirokal.

Shudhu tomar,
Dipto ♥
